sentences.text: Acmoniodus is a member of the class Chondrichthyes, the cartilaginous fishes, though it is also classified within the class Placodermi, the armored jawed fishes.
It belongs to the order Copodontiformes, but its family placement remains uncertain, with the Paleobiology Database listing Ptyctodontidae as a potential parent group.
The genus was named by Hussakof and Bryant in 1918, and the only known species, A. clarkei, was found in the lower Frasnian-aged Geneseo Shale of New York.
